svg.title: Accounts, journals, and posted detail
svg.desc: Accounts, journals, and posted detail. Which source identifier identifies the posted event? Primary tables: Account, JournalEntry, GLEntry. JournalEntry is one posting route. Operational sources and constructed PayrollSummary identifiers must not be treated as journal headers.
